strings: r_c0 tells m_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might have to accept that the leg that was so badly mangled will always be weaker now. At least {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} still {VERB/m_c/have/has} it... but that's cold consolation to m_c, who feels like {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} so close to healing perfectly.
r_c0 explains to m_c that the weakness {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} leg will likely always be present, a consequence of the severe damage.
